name: vol_regime_adaptive_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, intraday volatility clusters in two structurally distinct regimes visible at 5-second resolution. In LOW-vol regimes (ATR-14 below the 30th percentile of the rolling 240-bar intraday distribution), passive market makers dominate order flow — small Bollinger Band deviations below VWAP attract aggressive limit-order replenishment within 15-30 seconds because every algo benchmarked to VWAP has favorable fills; the bounce is mechanical. In HIGH-vol regimes (ATR-14 above the 70th percentile), institutional TWAP and momentum algos are simultaneously working larger directional orders, creating EMA-aligned bursts that persist 30-90 seconds because the underlying institutional queue is only 30-50% filled on the first visible bar — selling begets selling, buying begets buying. The strategy is flat in ambiguous MED-vol transitions where neither mechanism dominates.

indicators.name: ATR_14
indicators.purpose: 14 bars × 5s = 70 seconds of range data — enough to detect whether the current NIFTY volatility spike is genuine (multiple bars of large range) vs. a single-bar outlier. We use 14 bars to match the original's ATR(14) time concept but compress from 14-min to 70s to reflect that at 5s we care about NOW, not yesterday's regime.

indicators.name: ATR_Percentile_Rank
indicators.purpose: 240 bars = 20-minute rolling window to compute intraday ATR percentile. The original used a 5-day cross-session distribution; we switch to intraday 20-minute because NIFTY's vol regime is session-specific — pre-noon and post-noon regimes differ, and yesterday's vol distribution adds noise. 20 minutes gives enough sample (240 points) for a meaningful percentile without leaking yesterday's regime.

indicators.name: BB_upper
indicators.purpose: 20 bars × 5s = 100 seconds — the trigger for LOW-vol mean reversion entries. At 5s resolution, a 100-second BB captures micro-range deviations. Original used 20-bar 1-min BB (20 minutes); we compress to 100s because we are trading the first 15-60 seconds of a bounce, not the 10-30 minute reversion.

indicators.name: BB_lower
indicators.purpose: Same as BB_upper, symmetric lower band for bearish low-vol mean-reversion signals.

indicators.name: EMA_9
indicators.purpose: 9 bars × 5s = 45 seconds — the fast EMA for HIGH-vol momentum detection. Original used EMA(9) on 1-min bars (9 minutes). We keep 9 bars because 45s is long enough to distinguish genuine momentum from noise at 5s resolution, and the EMA9/EMA21 CROSSOVER is the signal, not the absolute level. Same bar count, different time compression.

indicators.name: EMA_21
indicators.purpose: 21 bars × 5s = 105 seconds — the slow EMA for HIGH-vol momentum confirmation. The EMA9/EMA21 gap in HIGH-vol regimes on NIFTY represents 2-4 minutes of institutional order flow confirmation; 105s slow EMA captures that without introducing excessive lag.

indicators.name: VWAP
indicators.formula: cumulative(close * volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative from 09:15 — no lookback scaling needed. VWAP is the institutional benchmark; deviations below (LOW-vol) or confirmation above (HIGH-vol) add directional conviction to either regime's signal.

conditions: LOW-VOL: stable_low (ATR_pct < 30 for 10 consecutive bars) AND close < BB_lower AND close < VWAP
HIGH-VOL: stable_high (ATR_pct > 70 for 10 consecutive bars) AND EMA9 > EMA21 AND close > VWAP AND volume > 1.5 * SMA(volume, 20)
buy_ce.confirmation: Signal fires on current bar close; no next-bar confirmation needed at 5s (original's 'next bar' was 1 min which is 12 bars here — too slow)

conditions: LOW-VOL: stable_low AND close > BB_upper AND close > VWAP
HIGH-VOL: stable_high AND EMA9 < EMA21 AND close < VWAP AND volume > 1.5 * SMA(volume, 20)
buy_pe.confirmation: Signal fires on current bar close

exit.stop_rationale: LOW-VOL: NIFTY BB deviations in calm periods are ~10-20 spot pts; an ATM CE/PE at delta 0.5 gains ~5-10 pts on the bounce — stop at 3 pts gives 1:1.67 R:R and allows for 5-10 spot pt reversion before declaring the thesis wrong. HIGH-VOL: 5 pts because momentum runs 20-40 spot pts; if NIFTY reverses 10+ spot pts immediately against our momentum entry, the regime classification was wrong.
exit.target_rationale: LOW-VOL: 5 pts = ~10 spot pt bounce, which is the median reversion from a BB-lower touch in calm NIFTY sessions (per Section 10.4, 30s moves are 2-5 option pts, 1-min 3-7 pts — our 60s hold targets the lower end of 1-min expected moves). HIGH-VOL: 8 pts = ~16 spot pt continuation, consistent with NIFTY momentum bursts in high-ATR regimes where 20-40 spot pt moves are common (Section 10.4: 2-min = 5-10 pts for NIFTY).

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 28 (extreme tail risk — above 28 NIFTY becomes ungovernable for ATR regime buckets; shift thresholds up by 10 pct if VIX > 22)
filters.time_filter: No entries before 09:25 (skip pre-open noise) or after 15:10
filters.volume_filter: HIGH-VOL entries: volume > 1.5x SMA(volume, 20); LOW-VOL entries: no volume filter (passive accumulation is low-volume by nature)
filters.trend_filter: Regime stability: must be in same regime (ATR pct) for 10 consecutive bars before entry — prevents whipsaw at regime transitions
filters.spread_filter: None — limit order execution at candle close prices, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — adaptive regime switching is conceptually well-known; the 5s implementation with intraday ATR percentile (vs. cross-session) is the differentiator. Regime windows and stability filters are the key knobs.

adaptation_notes: Three core changes from the original: (1) Universe changed from NIFTY50 stocks to NIFTY index — removes single-stock earnings/event risk and leverage the index's institutional flow dominance. (2) ATR percentile window compressed from 5-day to 240-bar (20-min) intraday — original's cross-session distribution is inappropriate for 5s intraday regime detection; today's regime can differ structurally from yesterday's. (3) Next-bar confirmation removed — at 1-min bars, next-bar confirmation was 1 minute; at 5s bars, waiting 5 seconds adds negligible conviction but costs premium time value. The regime stability requirement (10 consecutive bars) replaces the confirmation function. (4) Hold time compressed from 10-60 min to 15-60 seconds — capturing the first leg only.
weaknesses: MED-vol dead zone (~40% of intraday time) leaves capital idle — same as original but now more visible at 5s resolution where transitions are frequent
ATR percentile window of 240 bars can be contaminated by the opening 20 minutes' high-ATR readings, artificially suppressing the rest of the session into LOW-vol regime
EMA crossover in HIGH-vol regime can generate whipsaws during NIFTY news spikes (RBI, US data) where direction reverses within 30 seconds
Volume proxy for NIFTY index is futures volume — may not align perfectly with index spot movements on expiry days
